indices: Token, byte and bit indices are zero-based. Block numbers are one-based. Ranges are end-exclusive. Bits within bytes are LSB-first.

token_arrays.extra_field_starts: lbit/dbit point after the relevant Huffman code, to the first extra bit. Nonmatching token entries are zero.
token_arrays.eob: symbol256, length0, distance0; emits no output

per_output_arrays.bytes.bin: uint8 nominal output with zero incoming dictionary
per_output_arrays.fresh.bin: uint8: directly emitted literal1, copied byte0
per_output_arrays.origins.bin: int32: nonnegative literal token index; negative initial dictionary coordinate
per_output_arrays.tags.bin: int32: known byte value0..255; unknown initial dictionary coordinate-32768..-1

history_identity: -k means dictionary index32768-k. Equality of negative identities is invariant to dictionary values; inequality of identities does not prove unequal byte values.
ambiguities.u32: uint32 sorted global stream bit coordinates of observed-space bit5 alternatives retained in block bodies
inverse.bin: uint8 CP1252-style inverse conversion used by the app
inverse_offsets.u32: uint32 starting UTF-8 capture byte coordinate for each inverse codepoint
inverse_unmapped.u8: uint8:1 when the inverse conversion substituted '?' for an unsupported codepoint

part_fields.end: global assembled stream bit end, including a synthetic EOB if present
part_fields.sourceEnd: global retained-source bit end before a synthetic EOB
part_fields.headerBit: first retained bit inside the block's post-insertion prepared byte array
part_fields.originalEnd: original inverse byte block end before removals
part_fields.retainedPreparedEndBit: local prepared-stream retained bit end after CR insertion
part_fields.files: paths relative to the cache directory

part_arrays.rawPrepared: uint8 source after header patch/insertion and removals, before body NUL/CR choices; recipe prepared coordinates index this array
part_arrays.rawMap: int32 original inverse coordinate per rawPrepared byte; inserted header byte encoded as-anchor-1
part_arrays.preparedBytes: uint8 after body NUL/CR choices; before global BFINAL and stream XOR edits
part_arrays.map: int32 original inverse coordinate per preparedBytes byte; inserted byte encoded as-anchor-1
part_arrays.prep: uint32 rawPrepared index per preparedBytes byte
part_arrays.preparedFlags: uint8 provenance bit flags; not a source-authentication mask

prepared_flags.16: unsupported Unicode codepoint in inverse conversion

source_mapping: For retained global stream bit b: q=b-part.start+part.headerBit; j=q>>3; maps indexed by j; inverse/prepared bit=q&7. UTF-8 uploadedByte denotes a codepoint start, not an equivalent raw source bit.
diagnostics: Nominal selected distances only. First/final data tokens and L258 excluded from endpoint count. Same-symbol absorption requires contiguous following literal and canonical same length-symbol range. No all-distance-selector proof is claimed.
